map.检查 PDF 文件是否包含数字签名：解析 PDF 内部的 ByteRange 与: Check whether a PDF contains a digital signature: it parses the internal ByteRange and Contents references to detect whether a signature exists (without cryptographic verification) — all parsing is local and nothing is uploaded.
map.检查 PDF 中的数字签名信息。: Inspect the digital signature information in a PDF.
map.：数字签名基于 PKI，签名者对文档摘要做私钥加密，验证方用证书公钥验签。: : a digital signature is based on PKI — the signer encrypts the document digest with a private key and the verifier checks it with the certificate's public key.
map.：是否存在签名字段、签名者、时间、证书颁发者与有效期。: : whether a signature field exists, plus the signer, time, certificate issuer and validity period.
map.：文档被修改后摘要变化，签名即失效，可据此判断是否被篡改。: : modifying the document changes the digest, which invalidates the signature — a way to tell whether the file has been tampered with.
map.：本工具仅解析结构；完整验签需专业 PDF 库与信任链配置。: : this tool only parses the structure; full signature verification requires a professional PDF library and trust chain configuration.
map.💡 本工具检测签名\"是否存在\"（基于 PDF 结构），不做签名内容有效性验证: 💡 This tool detects whether a signature exists (based on the PDF structure) and does not verify the validity of the signature content. Files are parsed on your machine only and are never uploaded.
map.检查 PDF 中的 /ByteRange 与 /Contents 签名结构（不验: Check the PDF's /ByteRange and /Contents signature structures (without verifying PKCS#7 content or the certificate chain).
map.收到电子合同后先做结构核查：确认文件含签名结构、查看覆盖字节数，再用专业验签工具: For an electronic contract, first run a structural check: confirm the signature structures exist and inspect the covered byte count, then use a professional verification tool to check the signer and integrity.
map.读取 /ByteRange 与 /Contents，判断签名结构是否存在，并显示: Read /ByteRange and /Contents, determine whether the signature structures exist, and show the covered byte count; it does not issue a cryptographic valid/invalid verdict.
map.为什么“检测到签名”不等于验签通过？: Why does "signature detected" not mean verification passed?
map.本工具只用正则查找 /ByteRange 和 /Contents，统计两段覆盖长: This tool only searches for /ByteRange and /Contents with a regex and sums the two covered lengths; it does not compute digests, parse PKCS#7, or validate the certificate chain. Full verification requires a dedicated PDF library.
map.为什么可能提示未检测到签名？: Why might it report no signature?
map.签名值可能位于对象流、交叉引用流或增量更新中，正则读不到；未命中只代表本页的结构: Signature values may live in object streams, cross-reference streams, or incremental updates that the regex cannot read. A miss only means this page's structural scan found neither marker; it does not prove the file is unsigned. Verify with a dedicated PDF library.
map.PDF 签名结构检查：判断文档是否包含 ByteRange 与 Contents: PDF signature structure check: determine whether the document contains both ByteRange and Contents structures and report the covered byte range.
map.用于合同、票据等文件的初步结构核查；本工具不给出“有效/无效”密码学结论，也不能: Use it for a preliminary structural check of contracts, invoices and similar files; this tool issues no cryptographic valid/invalid verdict and is not a substitute for professional signature verification. Files are parsed locally and never uploaded.
map.检测规则：文件头须匹配 %PDF-x.y 模式；正则提取 /ByteRange: Detection rules: the file header must match the %PDF-x.y pattern; a regex extracts /ByteRange [offset length offset length], where the signed coverage length = the sum of the two lengths (2nd parameter + 4th parameter) bytes; it extracts the /Contents hex string; having both ByteRange and Contents marks the file as containing signature structures (no digest computation, PKCS#7 parsing, or certificate-chain validation)
